patches_modified.name: AI Writing Tools
patches_modified.description:
啟用 AI 撰寫工具，支援所有語言
Enable AI writing tools with support for all languages.

patches_modified.name: Access Points menu style
patches_modified.description:
切換新版或舊版 Access Points 選單樣式
Switch between the new and legacy Access Points menu styles.

patches_modified.name: Add Gboard Signature Bypass
patches_modified.description:
攔截 Gboard 的簽章白名單檢查並強制通過
Bypass Gboard signature whitelist checks and force them to pass.

patches_modified.name: Advanced Voice Typing
patches_modified.description:
啟用進階語音輸入（包含自動標點功能），並另外為不支援進階語音輸入的繁體中文語音啟用自動標點
Enable Advanced Voice Typing with automatic punctuation, and separately enable automatic punctuation for Traditional Chinese voice typing, which does not support Advanced Voice Typing.

patches_modified.name: Change emoji size
patches_modified.description:
變更表情符號大小
Change emoji size.

patches_modified.name: Clipboard Custom Character Limit
patches_modified.description:
自訂每個文字剪貼簿項目的最大字元數
Customize the maximum character count for each text clipboard item.

patches_modified.name: Clipboard Enhancements
patches_modified.description:
增強剪貼簿的保留時間、數量上限、預覽行數、倒數/建立時間、順序編號與欄數
Enhance clipboard retention time, item count limit, preview lines, countdown/creation time labels, order index, and column count.

patches_modified.name: Custom Symbols
patches_modified.description:
新增獨立的特殊符號分頁，長按逗號->愛心
Add a dedicated custom symbols tab and replace the long-press comma entry with a heart shortcut.

patches_modified.name: Developer options
patches_modified.description:
啟用 開發人員選項 與 Flag 編輯器，你可以自己修改Flag的值
Enable Developer options and the Flag Editor, allowing you to modify flag values.

patches_modified.name: Emojis, stickers & GIFs Tab Order
patches_modified.description:
自訂 Gboard「Emojis, stickers & GIFs」底部 tabs 的排序，支援拖曳調整
Customize the bottom tab order in Gboard's Emojis, stickers & GIFs panel with drag-and-drop reordering.

patches_modified.name: Enable Inline Autofill Suggestions
patches_modified.description:
啟用內嵌自動填入建議
Enable Inline Autofill Suggestions

patches_modified.name: Enable OCR / Scan Text
patches_modified.description:
啟用 OCR / 掃描文字功能，支援 拉丁、中文、日文、韓文 與 天城文 辨識後端
Enable the OCR / Scan Text feature with Latin, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Devanagari recognition backends.

patches_modified.name: Enable accessibility layout
patches_modified.description:
啟用無障礙鍵盤配置
Enable accessibility layout.

patches_modified.name: Enable cursor trackpad mode
patches_modified.description:
長按空白鍵開啟游標觸控板與鎖定模式
Long-press the space bar to use cursor trackpad and lock modes.

patches_modified.name: Enable split keyboard
patches_modified.description:
啟用分離式鍵盤
Enable the split keyboard layout.

patches_modified.name: English QWERTY Up-Flick Uppercase
patches_modified.description:
英文 QWERTY 鍵盤上滑大小寫
Flick up on the English QWERTY keyboard to toggle uppercase and lowercase.

patches_modified.name: G Logo on Spacebar
patches_modified.description:
在空白鍵顯示 G Logo，並隱藏語言名稱
Show the G Logo on the spacebar and hide the language label.

patches_modified.name: Grammar Checker
patches_modified.description:
啟用 修正和建議 > 文法檢查
Enable Text correction > Grammar check.

patches_modified.name: Incognito Mode Toggle
patches_modified.description:
在 Access Point 工具列新增無痕模式切換按鈕，並可設定無痕模式下是否啟用剪貼簿與語音輸入
Add an Incognito toggle to the Access Point toolbar and configure clipboard and voice typing availability while Incognito mode is active.

patches_modified.name: Inline Suggestions
patches_modified.description:
啟用 修正和建議 > 智慧撰寫
Enable Text correction > Smart Compose.

patches_modified.name: Key Shape Selection
patches_modified.description:
啟用圓角按鍵，主題詳情 > 按鍵形狀
Enable Key shape in Theme details.

patches_modified.name: Latin Globe Key Ignore Interval
patches_modified.description:
新增英文鍵盤地球鍵忽略時間覆寫，可獨立控制輸入後切語言延遲
Add an independent English globe key ignore interval override for post-typing language-switch delay.

patches_modified.name: Long-Press Editing Shortcuts
patches_modified.description:
在英文 QWERTY 與注音鍵盤加入全選、復原、複製、剪下、貼上與重做長按快捷鍵
Add Select all, Undo, Copy, Cut, Paste, and Redo long-press shortcuts to English QWERTY and Zhuyin.

patches_modified.name: Package Rename
patches_modified.description:
將套件名稱改成 dev.jason.com.google.android.inputmethod.latin 以便共存安裝
Rename the package to dev.jason.com.google.android.inputmethod.latin so it can be installed alongside the official Gboard.

patches_modified.name: Settings Homepage Override
patches_modified.description:
允許切換新版或舊版 Gboard 設定頁面
Allow switching between the new and legacy Gboard settings pages.

patches_modified.name: Swipeable Custom Top Row
patches_modified.description:
滑動鍵盤第一排，在原生列與可自訂文字/JavaScript 列之間切換
Swipe the keyboard top row to switch between the stock row and a customizable text/JavaScript row.

patches_modified.name: Use Bluetooth Microphone
patches_modified.description:
啟用 語音輸入 -> 使用藍芽麥克風
Enable Voice typing -> Use Bluetooth microphone.

patches_modified.name: Web Clipboard
patches_modified.description:
新增手機自架的 Web Clipboard，支援瀏覽器同步、配對碼與快速設定開關
Add the phone-hosted Web Clipboard with browser sync, pairing, and a Quick Settings Tile.

patches_modified.name: Zhuyin Bottom Row Key Sizes
patches_modified.description:
調整注音鍵盤底排按鍵大小
Adjust Zhuyin keyboard bottom-row key sizes.

patches_modified.name: Zhuyin Quick Traditional/Simplified Toggle
patches_modified.description:
注音 ㄥ 上滑快速切換繁簡
Swipe up on Zhuyin ㄥ to quickly toggle Traditional and Simplified Chinese.

patches_modified.name: Zhuyin Slide Input
patches_modified.description:
注音鍵盤支持上下滑輸入
Enable slide-up and slide-down input on the Zhuyin keyboard.

patches_modified.name: Disable Kaspersky background scan
patches_modified.description: Disables periodic Kaspersky scheduling and reports disabled workers as successfully completed.

patches_modified.name: Disable advertisements
patches_modified.description: Removes ad providers and ad identifiers, returns an empty ad list, and keeps advertising consent disabled.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics and trackers
patches_modified.description: Disables AppMetrica, MyTracker, AltCraft, Radar, install referrer, metrics, and audited logging transports.

patches_modified.name: Disable background hooks
patches_modified.description: Disables audited boot, network-state, VPN, and Connect session hooks.

patches_modified.name: Disable invasive permissions
patches_modified.description: Removes privileged install, location, storage, billing, USB, and vendor data access while preserving user-driven installs.

patches_modified.name: Disable push services
patches_modified.description: Disables RuStore and VK push initialization, services, and audited push receivers.

patches_modified.name: Disable verification hooks
patches_modified.description: Disables audited SMS, call, phone-state, SID, and Mail.ru verification hooks.

patches_modified.name: Hide gaming profile
patches_modified.description: Removes the gaming profile permission, hides both gaming buttons, and blocks navigation to the gaming profile.

patches_modified.name: Skip update authentication
patches_modified.description: Skips the update authentication suggestion and returns a valid completed result.

patches_added.name: Clone Gboard
patches_added.description: Changes the package name by appending a dot and custom suffix (defaults to 'kveld') to allow installing Gboard alongside the original application.

patches_modified.name: Disable In-App Training
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes periodic in-app training cache generation and federated-learning background work while preserving normal keyboard functionality and explicit user-requested operations.

patches_modified.name: Disable MDD Background Sync
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes Mobile Data Download (MDD) periodic background synchronization, automated polling, and prefetch worker tasks while preserving on-demand and user-requested downloads.

patches_modified.name: Disable Superpacks Eager Sync
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes eager background Superpacks synchronization during application startup, eliminating unnecessary disk sweeps and network polling while preserving on-demand pack downloads.

patches_modified.name: Disable WorkManager
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes background WorkManager initialization, database creation, and periodic maintenance workers.

patches_modified.name: Force Incognito Mode
patches_modified.description: Forces Gboard to always operate in incognito mode, disabling personalized learning and persistent input logging across all sessions.

patches_modified.name: Remove Wildberries ads
patches_modified.description: Removes Wildberries home banners, grid banners, profile banners, promo headers, product recommendations, and lottery popups.
